----Respondents
_____________________________________________________ For Petitioner(s) : Mr.
P a r d e e p C h o u d h a r y F o r R e s p o n d e n t ( s ) : M r . R . S . S h e k h a w a t , P . P . f o r S t a t e
VIJAY KUMAR VYAS Order 02/06/2017 Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

After taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case as well as the conviction and sentence awarded to the accused petitioner and the fact that he was on bail during trial as also in appeal, I deem it just and proper to suspend the sentence awarded to the petitioner, during the pendency of the revision petition.

Accordingly, the application for suspension of sentence is allowed and it is ordered that the sentence awarded to accused- petitioner Hariram S/o Shri Ramdev in Cr. Case No.47/2007 (2 of 2)
[CRLR-755/2017] passed by learned trial court for the offences u/s 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954 shall remain suspended; provided that he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.25,000/- and one surety bond in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court to the effect that he shall appear before this Court on 07.07.2017 and, as and when called upon to do so.

(VIJAY KUMAR VYAS),J.
Dheeraj/Jr.P.A./35 Hariram vs State Of Rajasthan And Anr on 2 June, 2017
